name: YouTube videos
description: The "Videos" tab of the search window: find notes by the videos attached to them (a front-matter list of YouTube IDs or links), see thumbnails and open the videos on YouTube. Also adds a top-bar button for the videos of the note you are reading. Hotkey, top-bar icon and place among the tabs are set in Settings → Search.

settings.name: Front-matter key
settings.desc: The property that holds a list of YouTube video IDs or links, for example youtube. It must be listed in indexedProperties in notes.config.json.

settings.name: Show thumbnails
settings.desc: Thumbnails are loaded from img.youtube.com, which tells YouTube that your browser is looking at those videos. Turn this off to avoid any request to YouTube until you open a video.

settings.name: Thumbnail quality
settings.desc: Higher quality looks sharper but downloads a larger image per thumbnail.

settings.name: Thumbnails per result
settings.desc: How many thumbnails fan out in a search result before the rest collapse into +N.

settings.name: Video button for the open note
settings.desc: Appears in the top bar only while the note you are reading has videos.
